scope: Offline validation of the already-correct Mission 1 environment source and its preserved candidate evidence.
permitted_actions: Verify frozen hashes and byte counts.
Compare current source with preserved candidate using SHA-256, byte count, and System.Collections.StructuralComparisons.StructuralEqualityComparer.
Prove the base-to-current change is exactly one authorized mobility line.
Create fresh validation receipts, inventory, diff, readiness, terminal evidence, and freeze artifacts.
prohibited_actions: Reuse or alter a failed namespace.
Invoke SequenceEqual on PowerShell byte arrays.
Launch Unreal, Blender, ShaderCompileWorker, AutomationTool, UnrealBuildTool, a compiler, a linker, capture, integration, or packaging.
Authorize or execute the native build during this gate.
